notes:
Texting beta 4: recall, reviews, receipts and group texts.

- Recall texts: the five recall steps now send, timed off Open Dental's recall due dates, never to a patient with an appointment scheduled. They start off: tick the recall types in Settings → Patient email → Recall, then turn on the steps you want. A reply to a recall text is flagged and assigned to the level you choose in Settings → Texting.
- Review requests: the day after a visit is set complete, at most once a year per patient, never to a patient marked "No review requests" (on the patient's Texts card). Set your review link in Settings → Texting first; it must be the same link as on your Texting card with Diastema.
- Text receipt beside Email receipt on the Payments page: the amount only, no link or card details.
- Group texts: Texts → Group text to patients scheduled today, tomorrow, in 2 or 3 days, the ASAP list or the Unscheduled List; untick anyone, up to 200, one text and one comm log line each.
- A Yes on the intake form's texting line is recorded as consent (never over a STOP).
- More than one automatic text a patient a day: each due text goes at its own time, inside texting hours.
- A minor's texts go to the number on their own chart; only a minor with no number falls back to the guarantor's.
